title: Marathon Reef Fishing Charters
blurb:
Experience the beauty of the Florida Keys, gorgeous turquoise water and abundant fish. Marathon the hub for fishing in the Florida Keys, great beaches, shopping, and fantastic food. View the beautiful scenery, while experiencing the thrill of a chance to catch species such as Wahoo, Mahi Mahi, Tuna, Snapper, Grouper, King Mackerel and Shark that all swim around the reefs.

 Your tour is guided by a licensed Captain in a modern 30' open fishing style boat with t-top for shade. All the fishing rods and reels, right and left-handed and all the tackle you need, as well as all other necessities including safety equipment.

Booking with confidence on TripAdvisor, it makes this charter an easy, reliable and enjoyable decision. Reserve Today to get hooked up! Travelers that have enjoyed our fishing charters also have enjoyed The Turtle Hospital, a tour down Seven Mile Bridge or a beautiful sunset at Sombrero Beach.
